rec.note_base: Fast even on a modest computer, average accuracy
rec.note_large: Most accurate and slowest; turbo is nearly as good
rec.note_medium: More accurate than small but noticeably slower; slow on a processor
rec.note_small: A sensible choice without an NVIDIA graphics card
rec.note_tiny: Smallest and fastest, but makes many mistakes
rec.note_turbo: Best for Russian and English: almost as accurate as large-v3 but several times faster; needs an NVIDIA graphics card

rec.reason_gpu_off_small: The {gpu} graphics card cannot be used for recognition ({why}) — on the processor ({threads}, {ram}) the small model recognizes speech reasonably fast
